title: Make debug rig attachment bones follow posed bones and pre-skinned mesh space
description:
## Summary
Correct the debug rig attachment-bone visualization so attachment points transform with their owning bones and are drawn at the corresponding pre-skinned mesh position.

## User Mandate
> Without implementing, capture as a task that the debug rig attachment bones don't transform with the bones themselves, and draw to the pre-skinned mesh position (e.g. rotating the head moves the eyes, but not their attachement point)

STRICT. Preserve the reported behavior and the requested pre-skinned mesh-space target. Do not silently narrow this to a visual offset or re-scope it to runtime skinning.

## Scope
Investigate and correct the SceneView debug rig attachment-bone/attachment-point transform path. Attachment points must inherit the owning bone pose and resolve into the same pre-skinned/rest mesh coordinate space used by the debug presentation. Keep the solution generic for body, limb, and accessory attachments; do not add a part-type-specific eye or head special case.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Debug rig attachment bones transform with the bones themselves under rotation and translation.
- Attachment points are drawn at the matching pre-skinned mesh position, not only at the unposed or stale attachment position.
- A controlled head rotation moves the eyes and their attachment point together, with no visible separation.
- Unrelated attachment points remain stable when a different bone is posed.
- The fix works for generic attachment metadata and does not encode an eye/head-only branch.
- Unity SceneView validation confirms the posed attachment overlay against the pre-skinned mesh presentation.

## Validation
Run the narrowest relevant editor tests, then perform manual Unity SceneView validation with a controlled head pose and an attachment-bearing generated creature. Capture the result in this task before closure.

## Findings
User-provided visual evidence shows the debug rig overlay following the visible eyes under head rotation while the attachment point remains at its prior position. The current issue is recorded for investigation; no source-level diagnosis has been claimed.

## Blockers
No implementation or validation has been performed in this task.

## Next Step
Trace the debug attachment drawing path and identify where bone pose transforms stop before the pre-skinned mesh-space position is computed, then add a focused regression check before implementation.
